newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Q3 housing construction falls 18 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Q3 housing construction falls 18 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Swiss housing construction activity was down 18 percent in the third quarter compared with the same period of 1995, the Federal Statistics Office said.
It said 11,000 homes were finished, down 18 percent. Permits issued fell around three percent to 11,500, and 43,800 homes were under construction, down 17 percent from a year earlier.
"Construction finished for around 32,000 homes in the first three quarters of 1996, which represents a drop of 3,700 units or around 10 percent from the same period in the previous year," it said.
